answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because canyon only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any pearl approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
